title: OCR route quality: spaces, page furniture, doubt marker (REQ-0054)
acceptance_criteria: AC1 diagnosis and cheap fix for lost spaces
AC2 furniture removal on OCR lines incl leaked header slice
AC3 OCR doubt marker feeds completeness gate; AI fallback off
AC4 extract-eval before/after on scanned synthetic families, no paid call

design.summary: rebuild OCR spacing from rawdict char boxes (gap constant calibrated on >=2 families), furniture filter tolerant of OCR spacing, ocr_doubt reason (glued/chars/furniture/lang_missing) -> [Incomplete: missing_text ocr_doubt] + sidecar uncertain + engine decline, hard marker when vie is missing; CLI TSV confidence and AI fallback deferred

implementation.summary: char-box respacing OCR_GAP 0.15 calibrated on 3 families, OCR-space-tolerant furniture filter, ocr_doubt reasons (glued/chars/furniture/lang_missing) -> Incomplete marker, sidecar uncertain, engine decline; missing-language error with install note; before/after measurement

unit_test.command: python3 -I -m unittest discover -s tests/unit (about 5 min, OCR tests)
unit_test.result: 1121 run, only the known failures (identical names to baseline); tester recount of before/after matches (family C glued 171/168 vs 173/170: alignment method); 4 mutations killed; 25 md + 2 PDFs identical to 4865a2c (PDFs after whitespace normalisation)

security.result: low: unbounded difflib input at pdf.py:249; otherwise clean (verify.md)

verification.command: python3 -I -m unittest discover -s tests/unit; OCR gap sweep and before/after on synthetic scanned families; independent tester recount
verification.result: REQ-0054: AC2 (furniture) and AC3 (doubt marker feeds gate, AI fallback off) passed; AC1 (spaces) and AC4 (measurement) delivered with limits: real-error rate A 10/10->1/10, B 10/10->6/10, C stays 10/10; wrong questions reaching solver unmarked A 1/10, B 4/10, C 4/10; false alarms 0/9 (A), 0/4 (B); residual single-character misreads go to REQ-0065; vie+eng installed by the user; failures identical to baseline 083d0e4

quality.reason: tester recounted before/after numbers independently on synthetic scanned families; mismatch table in qa-recount-mismatch.tsv

crosscheck.waiver: independent oracle = tester recount of ocr-before-after.tsv with its own script (docs/report/evidence/TASK-051/qa-recount.tsv) and mutation checks; mock/local only, no paid call
